title: Rework networking overlay to plugin-oriented Terraform modules
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Multiple environment overlays and ad-hoc networking templates have drifted over time. Changes to VPC topology (CNI, NAT, transit, egress gateways) require duplicative edits across overlays and block cross-region standardization. We also have tightly coupled Terraform modules that assume specific cloud primitives, making provider upgrades and multi-provider work difficult.

Goal: Introduce a plugin-oriented networking module surface that standardizes a small, stable contract of inputs/outputs and delegates environment-specific implementation to interchangeable plugin modules (eg. cni_plugin/aws_cni, cni_plugin/cilium, egress_plugin/natgw, egress_plugin/egress-vpn). This will reduce duplication, make provider upgrades safer, and allow incremental migration without mass refactors.

Scope:
- Define a minimal networking contract: subnet_tags, subnet_ids, route_table_ids, nat_map, egress_endpoints, vpc_id, shared_secondary_cidrs.
- Implement adapter modules for current AWS patterns (legacy-overlay, new-plugin) and a lightweight cilium adapter for K8s overlay testing.
- Migrate two non-critical workspaces (staging and infra-tooling) to consume the plugin interface as canaries.
- Upgrade aws provider to 5.8.x in the new modules and ensure provider pinning per workspace.

Approach:
1) Add new plugin-oriented modules alongside existing modules; do not change existing workspaces yet.
2) Implement feature-flag variable network_plugin = "legacy|aws-plugin|cilium-plugin" with default legacy for all workspaces unless switched.
3) Validate outputs with terraform plan/apply in canary workspaces.
4) Roll forward to prod groups after safety window and metrics verification.

Success criteria:
- New plugin modules pass unit/integ tests and are used by staging and infra-tooling workspaces.
- Number of diff lines when changing VPC topology reduced by >= 60% for migrated workspaces.
- No more than 1 rollback during canary migration.

Non-goals: Full removal of legacy modules in this ticket (will be follow-up once canaries are green).
acceptance_criteria: Plugin modules implement the agreed contract and expose required outputs
Staging and infra-tooling workspaces migrated using network_plugin variable and run successful apply without manual state surgery
Automated tests (unit terraform plan checks) added to CI for the new modules
Aws provider upgrade scoped to new modules with explicit pin and documented rationale
Confluence design doc and migration runbook linked in ticket
